review_text: Package showed delivered but never arrived. Seller took 4 days to respond and the marketplace's dispute form kept timing out.
Payout for last week's sales still shows 'processing' with no ETA. This is the second time we've had to chase support for our own money.
Ordered a handmade item and the seller shipped it a day early with a lovely personal note. This is why I keep coming back to this marketplace.
Searching for 'ceramic mug' returns mostly unrelated phone cases. The relevance ranking feels broken compared to a few months ago.
Item arrived clearly used and re-boxed as new. Refund request has been 'under review' for nine days now.
New listing analytics dashboard is genuinely useful for spotting which photos convert better. Would love to see it broken out by device type too.
Checkout worked fine but the estimated delivery date shown at purchase was six days earlier than what actually happened.
Bought what was listed as an authentic item and it arrived as an obvious counterfeit. Reporting the listing didn't take it down for over a week.
The new 'similar sellers' recommendation feature helped me find a small shop I now order from every month. Nicely done.
Referral/promoted listings fees increased with zero notice in the seller dashboard. Found out only when my margin took a hit.
Customer support chatbot looped me through the same three canned responses for a lost-package issue and never offered a human.
Return label generation is fast now and refunds landed in three business days once the item was scanned. Big improvement from earlier this year.
Left an honest 2-star review after a bad experience and the seller kept messaging me privately to change it. Reporting harassment felt like it went nowhere.
Inventory sync between the app and desktop dashboard lags by several minutes, which caused us to oversell a limited item twice this month.
Same-day pickup option for local sellers is fantastic. Got a birthday gift sorted two hours before the party.
Filtering by 'ships from my country' doesn't actually exclude overseas listings half the time. Ended up with a three-week shipping wait I wasn't expecting.
Reported a scam listing and it was taken down within an hour with a clear email explaining what happened. Felt genuinely protected as a buyer.
Account was suspended for 'suspicious activity' with zero explanation, freezing $3,200 in pending payouts. Appeal process has no visible timeline.
Return window is only 14 days but the item took 12 days to arrive in the first place, leaving almost no time to decide.
App is smooth day to day, though the 'track your order' map sometimes shows the package in a completely different city than reality.
Wish list feature works well but there's no way to be notified when a saved item goes on sale, which feels like a missed basic feature.
Bulk listing upload via CSV saved us hours of manual entry when we relaunched our shop. Exactly what a growing seller needs.
Two different sellers used stock photos for handmade items that clearly weren't what arrived. Marketplace's 'verified handmade' badge doesn't seem to be enforced.
Was charged twice for a single order due to a checkout glitch. Support confirmed the duplicate charge but said refunds 'can take up to 10 business days.'
Damaged item on arrival, uploaded photos, and had a replacement shipped free of charge within 24 hours. Couldn't ask for smoother service.
Messaging with buyers is fine but there's no way to send a mass update to everyone who ordered a specific item during a shipping delay.
My account got flagged and locked after a buyer falsely claimed non-delivery with tracking clearly showing delivered. Took three weeks and constant follow-up to restore.
Gift wrapping option at checkout is a small touch but made ordering a present feel effortless. Will use again for the holidays.
Category browsing on mobile is cluttered with sponsored listings that aren't clearly labeled as ads, which is frustrating when trying to compare prices.
Customer message auto-translate feature opened up sales to buyers overseas we'd never have reached otherwise. A few translations are a bit off but usable.
Seller refused a return outside their stated window even though the item was defective, and the marketplace's buyer protection didn't step in.
Appreciate the new seller verification badges, makes it much easier to tell established shops from brand-new ones with no track record.
Order arrived fine but the packaging was excessive for a single small item, felt wasteful for something that could've shipped in an envelope.
Shop analytics only show the last 30 days of data. As a seasonal seller I need to compare year over year, and there's no export option.
Voice search actually understood 'blue ceramic vase under $30' correctly on the first try. Small thing, saved real time.
Refund processed correctly but the notification email came four days after the money was actually back in my account, which was confusing.
Buyer protection covered a non-delivery claim quickly and without hassle, even reimbursing return shipping. Exactly what I'd want from a marketplace.
New fee structure buries the actual percentage taken per sale across three different pages. Had to contact support just to understand my own margins.
Order confirmation and shipping notification both arrived, but the actual item took two extra weeks with no proactive update from the seller or the platform.
Recently viewed items carousel on the homepage is genuinely handy for going back to something I almost bought last week.
